textContent.value:
- All families can sign up for the event
- Each day your family will randomly face another family in a battle
- The battle will be the whole day and based on ranking points, the family with the most points during the day will win
- Winner and loser families will get rewards
- Rewards will be sent to the family owner
- There will be a lucky draw for all family members

How to get points: 
Send 1 diamond, receive 1 bean = 1 point
Go live, watch live for 1 min = 1 point (Max 900 points per day)
Invite a new member to your family = 200 points

- Rewards are per day
- Rewards are for winner and loser based on their points, the winner is the family with the most points at the end of the day
